title: call.line
description: The line's hold and mute flags after one of them changed. Both are stated so a reader never has to remember the other.

CallLine.description: The line's hold and mute flags after one of them changed. Both are stated so a reader never has to remember the other.

held.description: True while the caller is on hold and hears nothing from the agent.

muted.description: True while the agent produces no audio.
